name: typing-speed
description: 📝 Test your typing speed and accuracy with this interactive web application, featuring real-time feedback and a responsive design for all devices.

paragraphs: Welcome to the typing-speed application! This is a simple and interactive Typing Speed Test web application. It uses HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to provide you with a real-time platform to test your typing speed and accuracy. This tool is perfect for anyone looking to practice their typing skills or showcase frontend development capabilities on GitHub.
features: User-Friendly Interface: Designed for ease of use, with clear instructions.
Real-Time Feedback: Receive instant results to track progress.
Customizable Text: Choose different sentences for practice.
Statistics Tracking: Review your performance to see improvement tips.
